detail:
Field defect D11 (wave-2 handoff) investigated by agent, load-bearing claims re-verified by controller against HEAD 429a2d2 and this repo's live store.

D7 STATUS: NOT FIXED, and never tracked (no commit/changelog/doc mentions D7; 2.7.0 = D1-D5 only). Mechanism is double-locked: (1) the nested decisions[] object schema (record-tools.ts:190-249) and StructuredDecision interface (:109-124) have no affected_files/affected_symbols; zod v3 objects default to strip, no .strict()/.passthrough() anywhere in src/, so the unknown key vanishes silently with a success response; (2) even if the schema accepted it, the per-decision loop applies the session-level value uniformly AFTER the input spread — affected_files: args.affected_files ?? [] (record-tools.ts:416). buildFromStructured (:126-148) forwards nothing. Shipped 1.25.0 plugin bundle carries the identical schema. Docs manufacture the defect: BEHAVIORS.md DECIDE-06 tells agents to include affected_files but lives under twining_decide, which is OFF the default surface (decision-tools.ts:18, server.ts:257 full_surface default false); the tool agents actually have accepts the field only batch-wide. No test asserts a structured decision's file list reaches the store.

D11 CONFIRMED: complete decision mutation surface is create/updateStatus/linkCommit (interfaces.ts:59-77). Mutable: status, superseded_by, overridden_by, override_reason, archived_from, commit_hashes. Everything else write-once. No amend/patch tool anywhere. The field's corrective-second-record workaround is permanent (housekeeping dedup is blackboard-only) and fires a spurious conflict finding (decisions.ts:396-408).

DOGFOOD REPRODUCTION (controller-run): 89/487 decisions (18.3%) carry empty affected_files vs field's 540/3052 (17.7%) — systemic, in the tool not the usage. WORSE: 41 of the 89 also have scope "project" (git-inference fallback, record-tools.ts:329) — with bidirectional-prefix scopeMatches, those have ZERO retrieval edges: invisible to why-on-any-file, assemble file directives, graph, drift check. ~46% of empty-list decisions are effectively write-only.

CONSEQUENCE MAP (11 sites key on affected_files): hard-skipped — verify drift check (verify.ts:349-353, also excluded from decisions_checked so the check reports a clean pass over a shrunk population), staleness signal 2 (staleness.ts:91-101; with index-only dashboard path a decision becomes unflaggable by construction), graph decided_by edges (graph-auto-populator.ts:49-61 — no file entity, no edge, orphan concept node, starves reachability boost and entity-scope-repair), test-coverage derivation (verify.ts:159-195, graph.ts:209-227 — permanently uncoverable), FILES TO CHECK lane (context-assembler.ts:713-733). Degraded — getByScope retrieval, whySpecificity tier, keyword scoring, export, dashboard health, rendered Files: line.

AMEND DESIGN NOTES (verified): updateStatus already Object.assigns arbitrary Partial<Decision> in both backends and is mirror-wrapped — D11 is a missing TOOL, not missing machinery. No embedding reindex needed if restricted to affected_files/affected_symbols (decisionEmbedText = summary+rationale+context only, embed-text.ts:18-22). FOUR INVARIANTS: (1) file-backend updateStatus writes extra to the record but only status to the index (decision-store.ts:117-128, controller-verified) — index carries affected_files that getByScope reads, so a naive amend produces a half-repair WORSE than today; need a real amendMetadata that rewrites the index entry, or gate to sqlite; (2) ExportingDecisionStore is hand-written delegation — a new store method not added there silently stops mirroring and next ingest (file-wins) REVERTS the amendment; (3) graph relations are append-only and never deduplicated — amend must add edges for newly-added paths only, never re-run onDecide; (4) allow amending retired records (housekeeping.ts:439 precedent for status-preserving metadata write).

DESIGN QUESTION for field response: per-record twining_amend means 540 manual calls. entity-scope-repair.ts is the standing precedent for the better shape — an opt-in dry-run housekeeping pass deriving affected_files from commit_hashes (git show --name-only) with twining_amend as the per-record escape hatch. Price both. This also converges with D13 ask 1 (derive edges from commit provenance, marked inferred).
summary: D11 confirmed + D7 NOT fixed: nested decision schema never had affected_files (record-tools.ts:109-148, zod strips); no amend path exists; dogfood store reproduces field ratio — 89/487 empty (18.3%)
